observations.finding: Central facade has approximately10 repeated vertical bays between the two tall glazed end cores; approximately9 intermediate tall piers. About5 horizontal opening/window-group tiers are visible.
observations.confidence: high for repeated bay rhythm, medium for tier count due shadows/vegetation
observations.limitations: These are opening groups, not individual glazing panes or a certified total window inventory. Lowest tier includes entrances/occlusion. Do not claim50 exact windows or exact total building floors.

observations.finding: Light beige/gray square stone-panel cladding; deeply recessed central windows behind tall square piers; turquoise/gray glazing; two taller rectangular glazed end cores within projecting stone surrounds; lower outer wings. Facade top cornice/parapet is horizontal.
observations.limitations: Stone type, panel dimensions, pier section, glass properties, exact heights remain unknown.

observations.finding: Roof is flat in several rectangular zones with perimeter parapets; central long roof strip and shorter end/core roof pieces; central rear block projects toward northeast. Small roof objects are visible.
observations.confidence: high for flat roof and stepped outline, low for equipment identities
observations.limitations: Do not label rooftop objects as HVAC/solar/skylights or assign dimensions without another source. Off-nadir roof displacement is visible; use OSM footprint for ground placement.

observations.finding: Front-right wing has horizontal window groups and a relatively plain stone-clad narrow end face. Plan is a long bar with northeast central rear projection, not a simple filled rectangle.
observations.limitations: Entire rear and both side elevations are not sufficiently documented for exact window counts.

observations.finding: Raised landscaped terrace in front of building, with broad light-colored stair approaches from the front drive/forecourt; shrubs and trimmed trees flank the stairs. Central doors are at the recessed bottom tier.
observations.confidence: high for broad steps/terrace; medium for exact door positions
observations.limitations: Step/riser count, accessible ramp alignment, door leaf count and opening widths are unresolved. Main-front center below is a geometric proxy, not surveyed doorway.

observations.finding: Current-reference main gate is an open vehicular/pedestrian entrance without an overhead arch. Two low brick name walls have pale inset panels reading 인하대학교 and INHA UNIVERSITY with crest. Small brick guardhouse with flat light fascia/roof stands on the right when looking inward; crosswalk and signal poles are in front.
observations.confidence: high for2023 photograph, corroborated in overhead layout
observations.limitations: Wall height/length, exact street-light design and current traffic control operation not measured. Do not substitute historical1950 entrance or a neighboring campus gate.

observations.finding: Long narrow rectangular water feature lies on the main axis. Both sides have paved vehicle circulation and diagonal parking, then grass plots and tree rows. Transverse paths/roads divide the larger lawn plots. Trimmed evergreen trees border the pool; street lamps and small signs line the approach.
observations.limitations: Tree counts/species, current parked vehicles and temporary banners are scene assumptions, not fixed architecture.
